# vcp Provider

The VStack Cloud Panel (`vcp`) provider manages VStack Cloud Panel resources — servers, isolated networks, gateways, DNS zones, SSH keys, and affinity groups, as well as VMware Cloud servers and networks (`vcp_vmware_*`). Configure it with an API endpoint (`host`) and token (`key`), or the `VCP_API_URL` / `VCP_API_TOKEN` environment variables.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    vcp = {
      source  = "itglobalcom/vcp"
      version = ">= 0.1.1"
    }
  }
}

# The host and key can also be supplied via the VCP_API_URL and VCP_API_TOKEN
# environment variables, in which case they can be omitted here.
provider "vcp" {
  host = "https://api.example.com"
  key  = "your-api-token"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `host` (String) API host URL. Can also be set via the `VCP_API_URL` environment variable.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) API key for authentication. Can also be set via the `VCP_API_TOKEN` environment variable.
